matched.title: Backstop deposit accepts zero-share mints, so a donation can capture a victim's deposit

findings.title: Backstop deposit accepts zero-share mints, so a donation can capture a victim's deposit
Reward-zone threshold uses a spot Comet balance that anyone can inflate by direct token transfer
Claim credits new LP shares to the recipient without updating its emission index, so the shares accrue historical BLND
Claim-to-LP deposit passes min_lp_tokens_out = 0, so the claimed BLND can be sandwiched
initialize() has no caller authorization, so the first caller can set the backstop token, emitter and pool factory
User share and emission records are written without extend_ttl, so idle depositors' balances can archive
gulp_emissions divides by zero total_non_queued_tokens when all reward-zone pools are fully queued
Emission index update divides by zero when every share of a pool is queued, which can block gulp_emissions for all pools
Pool draw can take tokens that back queued withdrawals

findings.title: Unpinned dependencies
Soroban contract arithmetic can wrap around in release builds
initialize() parameter order differs from the Backstop trait, so BLND and USDC addresses are stored swapped
LP token value is unwrapped before it is ever set, so pool_data and reward-zone checks panic until update_tkn_val runs
convert_to_shares divides by zero when a pool has shares but no tokens
User balance and user emission entries are written without extend_ttl, so idle depositors' shares and accrued BLND can be archived
Duplicate pool addresses in claim() overwrite the per-pool claim amount, so the LP tokens for part of the claim are never credited
load_pool_backstop_data divides by pool shares, so pool_data and add_to_reward_zone panic for pools with no backstop deposits
Pool backstop emission data is written to persistent storage without extend_ttl, and its archival bricks gulp_emissions and all pool deposit/withdraw/claim paths
Queue withdrawal accepts zero amounts and has no cap on queued entries
Drop list is kept in temporary storage and never extended on read, so drop() fails after the entry expires
